To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

• The NRC professional development project in literacy has been successful in providing opportunities for teachers in the US and in Guatemala to learn new techniques in the teaching of reading and writing, and to exchange educational practices.

• Teachers who are engaged in professional development initiatives that are designed to meet their individual needs are more likely to use the techniques they learn and share them with colleagues; • The professional development initiatives in literacy for culturally and linguistically diverse school communities, which are designed and implemented in the US and in Guatemala, provide teachers with a variety of opportunities to learn and share new ideas; and • The professional development initiative in Guatemala is a model for other countries that are interested in improving literacy instruction.
